hysteresis.note: architecture section 10.3 names a refinancing-pressure x balance-sheet-resilience/market-access quadrant, but the scoped owner artifact for this composer (data/capital_structure/projection.json) is an event/filing classification projection only -- it explicitly types the instrument-level substance both axes would need (maturity/refinancing terms, cash runway, financing capacity) as not currently published, at both the whole-projection level and every individual issuer record. No quadrant score is estimated from event-classification metadata alone; the real, honestly-aggregable coverage and event census is published under metrics instead.

subtitle.en: Refinancing pressure x balance-sheet resilience/market access
subtitle.zh: 再融资压力 × 资产负债表韧性/市场准入

text.en: No refinancing-pressure x balance-sheet-resilience/market-access state is asserted: the scoped owner projection publishes capital-structure EVENT and FILING classification metadata only, and explicitly discloses the instrument-level terms both axes would need (maturity/refinancing capacity, cash runway) as not currently published. Rather than estimate a fabricated score, the real event and issuer census is published as metrics instead.
text.zh: 未给出再融资压力 × 资产负债表韧性/市场准入状态：所设定的所有者投影仅发布资本结构事件与文件分类元数据，并明确披露两轴所需的工具层面条款（到期/再融资能力、现金续航）目前尚未发布。为避免虚构评分，改以指标形式发布真实的事件与发行人普查数据。

text.en: The owner-published projection covers 2374 issuers and 6996 capital-structure events this cycle (2717 classified, 3584 deferred pending further review) -- a filing-classification census, not a risk score.
text.zh: 所有者发布的投影本周期覆盖 2374 个发行人和 6996 项资本结构事件（已分类 2717 项，延期待进一步审查 3584 项）——这是文件分类普查，并非风险评分。

text.en: Across 2374 issuer records read this cycle: 956 have a classified latest event, 1495 sit in the owner's pending review queue, and 232 carry a shelf-registration filing as their most recent observed event (a coarse market-access census, not a scored issuance-conditions index).
text.zh: 本周期读取的 2374 个发行人记录中：956 个的最新事件已完成分类，1495 个仍处于所有者的待审查队列中，232 个的最新观测事件为货架注册文件（这是粗粒度的市场准入普查，并非评分化的发行条件指数）。

text.en: The owner itself marks this cycle's discovery horizon as 'degraded_discovery' (latest_expected_index_not_observed; latest_filings_observation_missing). This composer passes that read through unchanged rather than smoothing it over.
text.zh: 所有者自身将本周期的发现视野标记为“degraded_discovery”（latest_expected_index_not_observed；latest_filings_observation_missing）。本组合器原样传递该判断，不做平滑处理。

text.en: The owner projection explicitly discloses the following capacities as not currently published, at both the whole-projection level and every issuer record: active_instrument_overhang, cash_runway, financing_probability, fully_diluted_shares, instruments, normalized_terms, offering_ability, remaining_capacity. Each is typed rather than silently omitted or estimated -- see the corresponding metric for each name.
text.zh: 所有者投影明确披露以下能力目前尚未发布，且在整体投影层面与每条发行人记录层面均如此：active_instrument_overhang, cash_runway, financing_probability, fully_diluted_shares, instruments, normalized_terms, offering_ability, remaining_capacity。每一项均以类型化方式呈现，而非被静默省略或臆造——具体见各自对应的指标。

text.en: This workspace reads exactly one owner path, the capital-structure event projection. Aggregate credit-spread and financing-cost context (named in architecture section 10.3) is not composed here even though a comparable reading exists elsewhere in this repository -- that context belongs to the Financial Conditions and Monetary Policy workspaces and is never duplicated into this one by reaching outside the scoped owner input. Issuer-level drilldowns and a portfolio exposure join are both request-time concerns; this composer never republishes the underlying records array itself.
text.zh: 本工作区仅读取一个所有者数据路径，即资本结构事件投影。架构第10.3节提及的综合信用利差与融资成本背景本处不予汇编，即便本仓库其他位置存在可比读数——该背景属于金融条件与货币政策工作区，不会通过越界读取所有者输入而在此重复呈现。发行人层面的下钻与投资组合敞口关联均为请求时概念；本组合器绝不会原样重新发布底层记录数组本身。

text.en: The owner artifact's own authority block agrees with this snapshot's fixed contract authority: context-only, no rank/entry/sizing/prophet authority.
text.zh: 所有者制品自身的权限区块与本快照固定的合约权限一致：仅限上下文，不含排名/入场/仓位/预言权限。
